verdict.rationale: OpenCode's official site says developers can log in with GitHub to use their Copilot account, or log in with OpenAI to use a ChatGPT Plus/Pro account. A community user independently reports running OpenCode on a $200/mo Codex subscription. Another community report says Anthropic shut down the side-loaded auth scheme, so the supported subscription list appears limited. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the subscription sign-in flow and its limits, and subscription sign-in support beyond Copilot and ChatGPT (e.g. Claude).
